content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1 — spike in 5xx from inference-gateway (private-vpc) across two AZs, automated threshold breach 10m ago. Paging @ops-oncall and @net-eng-priya

ops-oncall: Ack'd. I'm on it. grabbing context and running quick smoke checks.

net-eng-priya: I see SYN->FIN spikes in the gateway logs, a lot of backend TCP resets. Possible SNAT exhaustion or asymmetric return path. Pulling NAT metrics.

sre-jordan: Observing 504/502s from the private egress gateway to model-hosts: logs show 'connection reset by peer' and increased TCP retransmits around 18:12 UTC.

eng-mike: Quick note — a deploy to firewall rules rolled out ~18:05 in prod-2. Could be related. @deploy-bot, can you confirm recent firewall change?

deploy-bot: deploy:firewall-rule-update completed 18:06 by ci/cd (hash: a7f3c2) — rule group 'egress-restrict' applied to prod-2.

support-anne: Customer-facing: some customers report slower inference and occasional 502s. No data loss reported but increased latency and retries.

ops-oncall: Running `curl -v --resolve inference.internal:443:10.0.4.10 https://inference.internal/health` from bastion in prod-2 to see backend behavior. Getting TLS handshake then ``504 Gateway Time-out`` after TCP timeout.

net-eng-priya: NAT metrics: ephemeral port usage: 98% on nat-agg-1 in prod-2; conntrack entries spiked concurrently with deploy. Also seeing asymmetric flows: return paths hitting transit appliance in a different AZ with strict SG.

sre-jordan: Stack trace sample from gateway: ```
ERROR 18:14:12 httpx.TransportError: ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer')
  at gw/transport/conn.py:243
  at gw/proxy/handler.py:112
```

ops-oncall: Mitigation idea 1: temporarily open an extra SNAT elastic IP pool to nat-agg-1 and increase port range. Idea 2: rollback firewall rule if it's blocking ephemeral replies. We should choose minimal blast radius.

net-eng-priya: Agreed. I'm requesting an extra EIP allocation now and will attach to nat-agg-1. Also patching conntrack timeout to 30s for the busiest ips as a stop-gap.

eng-mike: If rollback is quicker, we can revert firewall rule in 2m. Which has lower customer impact?

ops-oncall: Allocate EIP first, attach, and then monitor. If no improvement in 5m, rollback firewall. Executing EIP attach now.

net-eng-priya: EIP attached to nat-agg-1 (allocation a0b1c2). Confirming SNAT port table expanded.

ops-oncall: Re-running health check from bastion: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://inference.internal/health` -> now returns `200 0.322` (was 504).

support-anne: Notifying impacted customers: "We've deployed an egress capacity mitigation; you may see reduced errors now. We'll follow up with root cause."

sre-jordan: Backend metrics show 5xx rate dropped from 18% to 0.8% over 7m post-EIP attach. Latency back to baseline. Keeping monitoring for 30m.

net-eng-priya: Additional root-cause notes: the firewall change tightened ephemeral return ports in prod-2 and combined with higher-than-expected NAT concurrency after a traffic spike, caused conntrack churn and return-path drops. The asymmetric route made cleanup slower. I'll prepare an exact timeline.

ops-oncall: TL;DR Mitigation sequence: 1) allocate extra EIP -> attach to nat-agg-1, 2) increase conntrack timeout for busy IP ranges, 3) rollback firewall if no improvement. Chosen path avoided rollback and traffic recovered.

eng-mike: Opening a canary to ensure config change won't reintroduce issue. @deploy-bot mark firewall-rule-update for revert candidate and hold further egress restrict rollouts.

deploy-bot: hold placed on release pipeline:egress-restrict for prod-2.

support-anne: Sent initial customer update and queued a status page entry: "Partial outage mitigated — elevated error rates resolved; investigating cause."

sre-jordan: Oncall handoff note for grave ops: monitoring window until 19:20 UTC, if stable assign postmortem to net-eng-priya and ops-oncall.

net-eng-priya: I'll grab packet captures (tcpdump) from nat-agg-1 and the transit appliance, plus conntrack dumps. Attaching artifacts to postmortem.

ops-oncall: If anyone sees error rate bump again, escalate to PGO and we'll run emergency rollback. For now, moving to status: mitigating -> stabilized.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> status changed to "stabilized" by ops-oncall at 18:26 UTC.

support-anne: Customer update sent at 18:28 UTC.

sre-jordan: Closing thread for now; re-open if anomalies. Postmortem ticket: PM-4821 assigned to net-eng-priya, ops-oncall.

net-eng-priya: Notes for postmortem: include action items — expand SNAT pool per AZ automatic thresholds, add preflight test for firewall ephemeral port rules, improve routing symmetry checks in deployment pipeline.

ops-oncall: Thanks team. Good catch on the asymmetry + conntrack interplay. :thumbsup:
